title: Advanced Spatial Analysis
text: phenoscapR provides rich set spatial statistics beyond basic nearest neighbours density estimation. vignette demonstrates: Neighbourhood Enrichment — permutation test phenotype co-localisation Ripley’s K — global clustering / dispersion measure Moran’s — spatial autocorrelation continuous variable Quadrat Analysis — complete spatial randomness test Pair Correlation Function — scale-dependent g(r) Cross Nearest-Neighbour Distance — inter-phenotype proximity Delaunay Network — cell contact graph Expression Clustering — marker-expression-based cell clusters

title: Advanced Spatial Analysis
code: library(phenoscapR)  set.seed(42) n <- 600  # Two spatially segregated populations coords <- data.frame(   x = c(rnorm(300, 250, 80), rnorm(300, 750, 80)),   y = c(rnorm(300, 400, 80), rnorm(300, 400, 80)) )  counts <- matrix(   c(     c(rnorm(300, 900, 150), rnorm(300, 200, 100)),  # CD3 high in pop 1     c(rnorm(300, 200, 100), rnorm(300, 800, 130)),  # CD8 high in pop 2     abs(rnorm(600, 600, 150)),                       # PanCK background     abs(rnorm(600, 400, 100))                        # DAPI   ),   nrow = n,   dimnames = list(NULL, c("CD3", "CD8", "PanCK", "DAPI")) )  obj <- CreateSpatialObject(counts, coords, project = "spatial-demo") obj <- NormaliseData(obj, method = "zscore") obj <- PhenotypeCells(obj, thresholds = list(CD3 = 0, CD8 = 0,                                               PanCK = 0, DAPI = -99)) table(Idents(obj)) #>  #> CD3+/CD8+/PanCK+/DAPI+             CD3+/DAPI+      CD3+/PanCK+/DAPI+  #>                      1                    126                    170  #>             CD8+/DAPI+      CD8+/PanCK+/DAPI+                  DAPI+  #>                    159                    137                      4  #>           PanCK+/DAPI+  #>                      3

title: Advanced Spatial Analysis
text: Tests whether phenotype pairs co-localise (less) expected random chance using permutation approach:
code: # Run with n_perm = 100 or more for reliable p-values ne <- NeighbourhoodEnrichment(obj, radius = 80, n_perm = 20) ne

title: Advanced Spatial Analysis
text: Assesses global spatial clustering across range radii. Values theoretical CSR line indicate clustering:
code: rk <- RipleysK(obj) rk

title: Advanced Spatial Analysis
text: Quantifies spatial autocorrelation continuous variable (e.g. marker intensity). Values near +1 indicate strong spatial clustering high/low values; values near −1 indicate regular spatial dispersion:
code: mi <- MoransI(obj, feature = "CD3", radius = 100) mi

title: Advanced Spatial Analysis
text: Divides tissue regular grid tests Complete Spatial Randomness (CSR) using chi-squared test. Significant results indicate non-random spatial distribution:
code: qa <- QuadratAnalysis(obj, nx = 4, ny = 4) qa

title: Advanced Spatial Analysis
text: pair correlation function g(r) derivative Ripley’s K measures clustering inhibition specific distance r. g(r) > 1 indicates clustering; g(r) < 1 indicates inhibition:
code: pcf <- PairCorrelation(obj) pcf

title: Advanced Spatial Analysis
text: Measures distance cell phenotype nearest cell phenotype B, providing directed measure inter-phenotype proximity:
code: cn <- CrossNNDistance(obj, from = "CD3+CD8-", to = "CD3-CD8+") summary(cn$cross_nn_distance)

title: Advanced Spatial Analysis
text: Constructs cell contact graph based Delaunay triangulation. Useful cell-cell interaction analyses:
code: obj <- DelaunayNetwork(obj) SpatialNetworkPlot(obj)

title: Advanced Spatial Analysis
text: Cluster cells normalised marker expression profiles (k-means hierarchical). Useful discovering marker co-expression communities independently spatial position:
code: obj <- ExpressionClusters(obj, k = 4) table(obj$expr_cluster) CellMap(obj, colour_by = "expr_cluster")

title: Advanced Spatial Analysis
text: See ?NeighbourhoodEnrichment, ?RipleysK, etc. full parameter documentation. Combine spatial statistics InteractionMatrix() InteractionPlot() complete co-localisation picture.
